name: list-contact-imports
description: List contact imports from Resend. Optionally filter by status. Use to discover import IDs or review past imports.

limit.description: Number of contact imports to retrieve. Default: 10, Max: 100, Min: 1

after.description: Contact import ID after which to retrieve more (for forward pagination). Cannot be used with "before".

before.description: Contact import ID before which to retrieve more (for backward pagination). Cannot be used with "after".
